description: This Java class, PlaceholderFactory, provides static factory methods for creating instances of various Placeholder, PlaceholderResolver, and ExpressionResolver classes related to the Eclipse Ditto project. It enables creation and resolution of placeholders for different contexts such as headers, entities, policies, topics, and authorization in a modular way.

classes.name: PlaceholderFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static factory methods to create placeholders and resolvers for the Ditto model.

methods.name: newHeadersPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of HeadersPlaceholder.

methods.name: newThingPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ThingPlaceholder.

methods.name: newPolicyPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of PolicyPlaceholder.

methods.name: newEntityPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of EntityPlaceholder.

methods.name: newTopicPathPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of TopicPathPlaceholder.

methods.name: newRequestPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of a request-specific Placeholder<AuthorizationContext>.

methods.name: newPlaceholderResolver
methods.description: Creates a PlaceholderResolver based on a provided Placeholder and optional source.

methods.name: newPlaceholderResolverForValidation
methods.description: Creates a PlaceholderResolver for validation, without a source.

methods.name: newExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver initialized with given PlaceholderResolvers.

methods.name: newExpressionResolver
methods.description: Overloaded: creates an ExpressionResolver based on a list of PlaceholderResolvers.

methods.name: newExpressionResolver
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver for a single Placeholder with an optional source.

methods.name: newExpressionResolverForValidation
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver for validation with zero or more Placeholders.

methods.name: newExpressionResolverForValidation
methods.description: Creates an ExpressionResolver for validation with a dummy string and placeholders.

methods.name: newSourceAddressPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of SourceAddressPlaceholder.

methods.name: newConnectionIdPlaceholder
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of ConnectionIdPlaceholder.
